subject: peck_philip_1835

shot.build: stage, tree d4fae0e81 + 5 uncommitted figure file(s)

silhouette.what: Silhouette and fit of the clothes
silhouette.note: Blue double-breasted tailcoat cut square at the waist, buff waistcoat, pale trousers, black stock and top hat: the Met c.1833 outfit and Hornor's 1836 man on Broadway, who reads at street distance exactly as ours does at 10 m (a dark blue body, pale legs, a top hat).

folds.note: The tails hang straight and part at the back as the Met coat's do, but the trousers are straight from the waist: the Met pair is pleated full into the waistband and tapers to foot straps, which shows at 3 m.

hat_hair.note: Black top hat, as Hornor's men.

skin.note: Coloured pictures; a reconstructed face and complexion, no likeness asserted.

hands.note: Bare at the sides; the Met outfit is shown with gloves.

stance.what: How the figure stands or sits

motion.note: The tails swing and part mid-stride; the legs read through the trousers.

differences.picture: Full trousers pleated into the waistband, tapering to straps under the shoes (Met c.1833).
differences.ours: Straight pale trousers, no pleats at the waist, no foot straps.

differences.picture: Buff waistcoat showing in the coat's opening and below its square-cut front (Met).
differences.ours: Buff waistcoat V at the chest and a wide buff band at the waist below the coat front; the band reads as a sash.

differences.picture: Dark velvet coat collar, high rolled (Met; Reed's rolls to the jaw), black stock tied in a bow, white collar points at the cheeks (Reed).
differences.ours: Dark high collar, black stock; no shirt collar points show.

differences.picture: Notched lapels on the Met coat.
differences.ours: A V-opening with no lapels drawn.

differences.picture: Blue coat, buff waistcoat, pale linen trousers (Met, Hornor).
differences.ours: Navy blue coat, buff, off-white trousers.

differences.picture: Tails to the back of the knee (Met).
differences.ours: Tails to about the knee, split at the back.

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever laid the stills beside the pictures; each checklist item is {what, status, note} with status open | reads | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling — open when a visitor would see the figure is not the pictures’ kind of person in that respect. The first figure of each role is the owner’s call (the plan’s "Your call"); later figures of the role are held to the one he approved.
